status: draft hints written for ALEF from the shape of the modern print letters; not checked by a native teacher
note: Shown ONLY after a learner taps the wrong letter. Key = the two ids sorted alphabetically and joined by '|'. If a pair has no entry here, the hint of the confusables set containing both letters is used. A wrong tap between letters that never get confused shows no look-alike warning.

pairs.bet|kaf: Bet has sharp corners and its floor sticks out at the back. Kaf is one soft curve, like a backwards C.
pairs.bet|pe: Pe has a curl tucked inside at the top left. Bet is an empty box with a floor that sticks out.
pairs.kaf|pe: Look inside the top left: pe has a curl (a tongue), kaf is empty.
pairs.gimel|nun: Gimel has a foot kicked out at the bottom left. Nun's base is flat and stops at the stem.
pairs.dalet|resh: Dalet has a sharp square corner at the top right and its bar sticks out. Resh has a smooth rounded shoulder.
pairs.dalet|kaf-final: Dalet stays on the line with a square corner. Final kaf has a rounded shoulder and drops a long tail below the line.
pairs.kaf-final|resh: Both have a rounded shoulder, but final kaf drops a long tail below the line. Resh stays on the line.
pairs.vav|zayin: Zayin has a bar across the top. Vav is a plain single stroke.
pairs.nun-final|vav: Final nun is much longer and drops below the line. Vav stays on the line.
pairs.vav|yod: Yod is tiny and floats at the top. Vav is a full-height stroke.
pairs.nun-final|zayin: Zayin is short and has a bar on top. Final nun is a long plain stick below the line.
pairs.nun-final|yod: Yod is a tiny comma at the top. Final nun is a tall stick that drops below the line.
pairs.yod|zayin: Zayin is taller and has a bar on top. Yod is a tiny comma floating near the top.
pairs.chet|he: He has a gap between the left leg and the roof, like a window left open. Chet is closed all round.
pairs.he|tav: He has a gap in the left wall. Tav has no gap but a little foot kicked out at the bottom left.
pairs.chet|tav: Tav has a foot kicked out at the bottom left. Chet's left leg is straight and sits flush with the base.
pairs.mem-final|samekh: Samekh is soft and round. Final mem is a hard box with square corners.
pairs.ayin|tsadi: Tsadi has a flat base and a Y-shaped fork; its second stroke comes from the top right. Ayin sweeps in one curve and its second stroke comes from the top left.
pairs.pe-final|tsadi-final: Final tsadi forks like a Y on top. Final pe has a round top with a curl inside.
pairs.kaf|qof: Qof has a leg that drops below the line on the left. Kaf stays on the line.
pairs.mem|mem-final: Open mem has a gap at the bottom left. Final mem is closed all round.
